वैदग्ध, n., वैदग्ध्य वैदग्ध्य, n., and f. धी, i. e. वि-दग्ध (vb. दह्), + अ or य,
 1. Cleverness, skill,

वैदर्भ,
 A. i. e. विदर्भ + अ,
 I. m. The sovereign of Vidarbha, the father of Damayantī.
 II. f. भी.
 1. Damayantī,

. The law [] of Vidarbha, by which cousins-german were allowed to intermarry in that country.
 B. i. e. वि-दृभ् + अ + अ, n. Crafty or indirect speech.
 --Comp.

वैदल,
 I. i. e. विदल + अ, adj. Made of cane,

.
 II. m.
 1. A flat unleavened cake.
 2. Any leguminous vegetable or grain.
 III. n. A vessel of wicker-work, a basket made of reeds,

वैदिक, i. e. वेद + इक,
 I. adj., f. की.
 1. Relating to the Vedas,

. Scriptural, 2, 15.
 3. Recommended, ordained in the Vedas, 2, 2; 84; 8, 190.
 II. m. A Brāhmaṇa well versed in the Vedas.
वैदुष्य, i. e. विद्वंस् (vb. विद्), + य, n. Science,

वैदूर्य, i. e. विदूर + य,
 I. adj. Brought from Vidūra.
 II. n. A gem of a dark-blue colour, the lapis lazuli, Bhāg.
वैदूर्य + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of lapis lazuli,
वैदेशिक, i. e. वि-देश + इक, adj. Foreigner, a foreigner, Pañc. 184, 4.

वैदेह, i. e. विदेह + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The king of Videhā, father of Sītā, Utt.

. A trader by profession.
 3. The son of a Vaiśya by a Brāhmaṇa woman,
. pl. Descendants of mixed castes, Lass.

. An attendant on the women's apartments.
 II. f. ही.
 1. The wife of a trader.
 2. Sītā (the daughter of the king of Videhā),

. Long pepper.
 4. A sort of pigment, called Rocanā.

वैदेह + क, m. = वैदेह,
 I., cf.

वैद्य, i. e. वेद + य,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to the Vedas, Lass.

. Relating to medicine, medical.
 II. m.

वैद्य + क, m. A physician, Śṛṅgārat. 14.
